purpose: Post-generation semantic correspondence for diagnosis only; not independent gold evaluation or an automatic string-match score.
limitations: References were used in development and have mixed human/assistant provenance.
Mappings below are this reviewing assistant's judgments, not independently adjudicated labels.
Many-to-one and one-to-many mappings are allowed; counts are not precision or recall.
Coverage of meaning does not establish correctness of output origin labels or refinement edges.

mappings.note: The specific clothing/carrying goal is merged with the broad planning goal; its independent position in a hierarchy is lost.
Unfamiliar locations occur in context/evidence, rather than as an independent goal to learn local weather conditions.
The output adds a first-moment timing expression that needs checking.
Real-time updates appear as rain-specific notifications and timely/consistent data; the general outside-decision purpose is not a separate goal.
Quantity and the purpose of displaying activity are merged; this obscures a possible why/how relation.
Referral and recruiter visibility are merged; the accepted development reference kept them separate and related.
Lowering search cost is not the same as lifting search-result limits. This is an implied reference goal, so exclusion is not automatically an extraction error.
Improving employment chances is a higher-level inferred goal; output intentionally declines to add interview/job-offer goals without direct statements.
Broad instant communication and the no-contact-saving condition are merged.
Historical search and search-result precision are separated; possible redundancy depends on the chosen granularity.
Development reference says implied; output says explicit/direct although the stated evidence is a navigation difficulty.

excluded_design_extensions.reason: Human-added personalized presentation design extension; not a goal that must be extracted from the interview.
